menu:3142320:1.text: Oh, are you here to collect debts for the boss?
menu:3142320:1.source_cn: 噢，你是来替老板娘讨债的吧？

menu:3142340:1.text: What a surprise to see you!

say:1:1122531001:1.text: There's a job with a big reward for some stolen shipment. The only lead we got is the <style="highlight">innkeeper's wife</style>.
say:1:1122531001:1.source_cn: 最近有一批失窃的货物，赏金丰厚。唯一的线索在<styl...

say:2:1122531002:1.text: She promised to give me some information on the condition of helping her recover a debt from that scoundrel, Thaniel.
say:2:1122531002:1.source_cn: 老板娘答应我，可以把这份情报留给咱们。但有前提条件——...

say:3:1122531003:1.text: I already found out where he is. Thaniel is hiding in that tiny <style="highlight">valley on the west side of town</style>.
say:3:1122531003:1.source_cn: 最麻烦的环节我已经解决了——撒尼尔就藏在<style=...

say:4:1122531004:1.text: The rest is easy breezy, so I'll leave it to you.
say:4:1122531004:1.source_cn: 剩下的事很简单，就交给你吧。
say:4:1122531004:1.male: The rest is easy breezy, so I'll leave it to you.
say:4:1122531004:1.female: The rest is easy breezy, so I'll leave it to you.

say:1:1122533001:1.text: Don't hurt me, please! I said I was gonna pay her back!
say:1:1122533001:1.source_cn: 先别动手，我又没说不还钱。

say:2:1122533002:1.text: Tell you what... How about we play a round of Century Quest? If you beat me, I'll pay her back right away! With interest!
say:2:1122533002:1.source_cn: 这样吧，你和我玩一局百物牌。要是你比我还厉害，我立刻把...
say:2:1122533002:1.male: Tell you what... How about we play a round of Century Quest? If you beat me, I'll pay her back right away! With interest!
say:2:1122533002:1.female: Tell you what... How about we play a round of Century Quest? If you beat me, I'll pay her back right away! With interest!

say:0:1122534001:0.text: How...? How could I lose?! You definitely cheated!
say:0:1122534001:0.source_cn: 这怎么可能……怎么会有人玩得比我还好？！你绝对作弊了！
say:0:1122534001:0.male: How...? How could I lose?! You definitely cheated!
say:0:1122534001:0.female: How...? How could I lose?! You definitely cheated!

say:1:1122534002:0.text: You want me to pay! Dream on!
say:1:1122534002:0.source_cn: 哼，想让我还钱，做梦去吧！
say:1:1122534002:0.male: You want me to pay! Dream on!
say:1:1122534002:0.female: You want me to pay! Dream on!

say:2:1122534003:0.text: Now you're being unreasonable! I guess we'll just have to teach you a lesson!
say:2:1122534003:0.source_cn: 你这个人怎么完全不讲理啊！你要是这样，主人和满满只能教...
say:2:1122534003:0.male: Now you're being unreasonable! I guess we'll just have to teach you a lesson!
say:2:1122534003:0.female: Now you're being unreasonable! I guess we'll just have to teach you a lesson!

say:0:1122535001:0.text: Ow! Ow! Ow! Okay! I give up!
say:0:1122535001:0.source_cn: 疼疼疼……嘶，算你厉害！我认输总行了吧！
say:0:1122535001:0.male: Ow! Ow! Ow! Okay! I give up!
say:0:1122535001:0.female: Ow! Ow! Ow! Okay! I give up!

say:1:1122535002:0.text: Check my pack! There should be a <style="highlight">coin pouch</style> in there somewhere!
say:1:1122535002:0.source_cn: 你……你自己翻我的包吧！里面有个<style=high...
say:1:1122535002:0.male: Check my pack! There should be a <style="highlight">coin pouch</style> in there somewhere!
say:1:1122535002:0.female: Check my pack! There should be a <style="highlight">coin pouch</style> in there somewhere!

say:0:1122536001:0.text: This pouch is heavy. He actually told the truth this time!
say:0:1122536001:0.source_cn: 这个钱袋沉甸甸的，看来他这次没有撒谎骗人！

say:1:1122536002:0.text: Magister, let's hurry back and give this to the innkeeper's wife!
say:1:1122536002:0.source_cn: 主人，我们去把这个钱袋交给旅店老板娘吧！
say:1:1122536002:0.male: Magister, let's hurry back and give this to the innkeeper's wife!
say:1:1122536002:0.female: Magister, let's hurry back and give this to the innkeeper's wife!

say:1:1122537001:1.text: Bless the Dusk Lord... You actually got Thaniel to pay up!
say:1:1122537001:1.source_cn: 残阳神庇佑……你们竟然真的追回了撒尼尔欠我的钱！

say:2:1122537002:1.text: The amount is a bit off, though. Well, he does owe us a lot of money. He probably forgot the total amount.
say:2:1122537002:1.source_cn: 唉，不过数额还是有点对不上。毕竟他欠的实在太多，恐怕连...

say:3:1122537003:1.text: Anyway, thank you very much. I'll meet up with Silverbeak later and give him the information he wants.
say:3:1122537003:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，都多谢你了。银喙想要的情报，我待会就会给他。
say:3:1122537003:1.male: Anyway, thank you very much. I'll meet up with Silverbeak later and give him the information he wants.
say:3:1122537003:1.female: Anyway, thank you very much. I'll meet up with Silverbeak later and give him the information he wants.
